question: What is EWU's policy on cheating?

question: What are the requirements for the freedom fighter admission quota and tuition waiver?
answer:
The university reserves a 3% admission quota for the wards of freedom fighters of all categories, subject to their fulfillments of the minimum admission requirements at East West University [Page 223]. The minimum qualifications for admission to undergraduate programs include: a Minimum GPA of 3.00 in both SSC and HSC Examinations (Minimum GPA 2.40 in Diploma in Engineering under Bangladesh Technical Education Board); or, at least one first division, either in SSC or in HSC (no third division is allowed), or total GPA of 5.00 in both SSC and HSC examinations for children of freedom fighters [Page 176]; or candidates must have passed University of London and Cambridge GCE ‘O’ Level in at least five subjects and ‘A’ Level in at least two subjects, with specific grade requirements; or an American High School Diploma [Page 176].

The university considers a maximum 100% tuition waiver scholarship to the wards of wounded, deceased and financially needy freedom fighters, subject to the following requirements: the candidate must qualify in the EWU admission test; the candidate must provide proof that his/her parent was a freedom fighter [Page 223]. The tuition fee waiver will be continued provided that the CGPA in each semester remains 2.60 or more [Page 223]. To continue financial aid, undergraduate students must register for at least three courses (9 credits) in each semester [Page 223]. Financial aid is discontinued if any student of undergraduate program violates the East West University Disciplinary Code for Students and/or if his/her CGPA falls below 2.60 calculated on the basis of the grades earned in the last three consecutive semesters/one year [Page 223]. Additionally, these scholarships are not available to those students who have already spent the regular study time required for the programs (e.g. Bachelor’s degree program students are not eligible beyond the four years required to complete the course as a regular student), students who have already completed required minimum total credits for a degree, or students availing the advantage of retaking any course [Page 219]. No student is entitled to benefit from more than one scholarship/financial aid scheme at any point of time [Page 219].

question: What GPA must I maintain for a scholarship?
answer:
The GPA requirements for scholarships depend on the specific type of scholarship:

*   For 100% Tuition Free Merit Scholarships awarded to candidates scoring GPA 5.00 in SSC & HSC examinations, or those securing 7 A’s in ‘O’ Level and 3 A’s in ‘A’ Level examinations, students must maintain a minimum GPA 3.50 in each semester as a regular student [Page 219] [Page 177].

question: What is the minimum CGPA required to graduate?
answer: The minimum CGPA required to graduate for undergraduate programs is 2.00 [Page 25].

question: What is the fee for the admission form?
answer: Applicants can fill the admission forms online by paying Tk. 1,000 [Page 176] [Page 178]. The fee of the admission form for the Foreign Students is $13.00, payable in International Money Order in favor of EWU [Page 178] [Page 176]. An admission fee of Tk. 5,000 is applicable for Non-Degree students [Page 179]. The Admission Fee is (one-time & non refundable) Tk.15, 000/- [Page 179].

question: At what CGPA is a student automatically dismissed?
answer: A student whose CGPA falls below 1.0 after the first two or any subsequent semesters will be automatically dismissed from the university [Page 217].

question: What CGPA is required for the Medha Lalon Scholarship?
answer: The CGPA requirement for awarding Medha Lalon Scholarship is 3.50 [Page 224]. This scholarship is discontinued if a student's CGPA falls below 2.70 calculated on the basis of the grades earned in the last three consecutive semesters/one year [Page 224] [Page 225] [Page 226] [Page 227].

question: What percentage admission quota is reserved for freedom fighters wards?
answer: The university reserves a 3% admission quota for the wards of freedom fighters of all categories [Page 223]. Additionally, private universities are required to provide scholarships to 6 (six) percent of their enrolled students who are poor and meritorious, of which 3 percent is reserved for the wards of freedom fighters [Page 219].

question: What are the library hours on Saturday?
answer: The library hours on Saturday are 5:00 pm – 10:00 pm [Page 208].

question: What is the grade point for an A+?
answer: The grade point for an A+ is 4.00 [Page 216].

question: What CGPA is needed for Cum Laude?
answer: An undergraduate student graduating with a CGPA of 3.75 to less than 3.80 (out of 4.00) within four years will be eligible for the award ‘Cum Laude’ [Page 26].

question: How many credits are needed to graduate from the CSE department, not the MS in CSE?
answer: A minimum of 140 credits are required to graduate from the B.Sc. in CSE program [Page 24]. The Course Summary for the Department of Computer Science and Engineering (CSE) also lists a total of 140 credits [Page 114].
